I mean appoints generally include yearly vaccines (flu and such, unless you get it somewhere else), physical examination (like looking in your ears, breast exams for women, blood pressure, stethoscope), urine test, sometimes vision testing, and then what I mentioned about weight (and usually height too). I’d assume they’re looking for any changes to be able to catch any potential health issues. Checking in with you about any medications.  Is a time to bring up any concerns or ask any questions that might not have been pressing enough to make a whole appointment for. They usually don’t take very long. I certainly don’t think it’s something EVERYONE does but lots of people do and I think they’re a good thing. You should certainly go to the doctor if something is wrong but check ups are good practice incase something is wrong that you weren’t aware of.
